notes: Object and product of the section: [0012] to [0016] state a three-step purification of 环磺酮产品 ending in 纯化的环磺酮 at [0016]. One record per the shared identifier list; the section distinguishes crude from purified by adjective only and never by name, so no second record is created. This section only purifies it and states no quantity, no yield and no characterisation, so quantity, nmr and melting_point are null rather than objects of nulls. commercially_available is false because steps elsewhere in the document prepare it, which is what rule 11 asks; on this section alone the question is not settled, because nothing here makes it. Ames at [0012] was seen and deliberately not emitted: it is an assay, not a substance.

Generic in the summary: [0015] charges 吸附剂 with no identity and [0022] narrows it to 活性炭 or 硅藻土, both of which are emitted as their own records. Kept as an unresolved functional reference because that is what the summary states. role additive because the role enum has no value for an adsorbent. commercially_available null because a generic class cannot be answered. No quantity and no characterisation are stated.

Named at [0017] as a component of the 含水溶液 (aqueous solution) of step 1). [0017] joins 乙腈, 甲醇, 乙醇 and 二甲基甲酰胺 with the Chinese enumeration comma and so does not say whether one of the four or all four mixed with water is meant; the EN line reads them as alternatives with "or", which the Chinese does not state. The ambiguity is recorded, not resolved. The water content of the mixture is given as a range at [0018] and belongs to the reaction record, not to the identifier. This section states no mass, no volume and no characterisation for it, so quantity, nmr and melting_point are null rather than objects of nulls.

[0021] only, and [0021] is defective: it is missing a verb before 入含水溶液, so the phrase 有机溶剂萃取蒸馏、入含水溶液的步骤 cannot be read with confidence and the operation intended after the extraction and distillation is not recoverable from the text.
